hints.title: Reachable Predecessor Interval
hints.text: An index i is reachable if s[i] == 0 and there is at least one reachable index j in the window [i - maxJump, i - minJump].

hints.title: Sliding Reachable Window Count
hints.text: Maintain a running count of reachable positions within the valid jump window.

hints.title: Window Bounds Shift
hints.text: Slide the window forward with each step i, adding newly eligible points and removing expired points.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all jump predecessors naively takes O(n * (maxJump - minJump)) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sliding window tracking reachable predecessors operates in linear O(n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate maintains reachable count within sliding window [i - maxJump, i - minJump].
